title: Collecting Patient-Reported Experiences With Radiation Dermatitis in Breast Cancer Patients Undergoing Radiotherapy
official: Collecting Patient-Reported Experiences With Radiation Dermatitis in Breast Cancer Patients Undergoing Radiotherapy
summary: This study evaluates patient-reported experiences of radiation dermatitis in patients with breast cancer undergoing radiotherapy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults ≥ 18
* Patients diagnosed with breast cancer
* Currently undergoing or recently completed radiotherapy
* Willing to provide verbal/oral consent
* Willing to be recorded as they are answering the survey questions

Exclusion Criteria:

* Persons \< 18
* Inability to provide verbal consent
* Non-English speakers (unless translations are available)
* Not willing to be recorded
